summary: This clinical trial is studying how the drug Tirzepatide affects muscle and blood vessel health in older adults with obesity. Researchers want to learn how a 6-month treatment with this medication impacts muscle strength, muscle mass, and physical function. The study is currently looking for participants who meet the health and age requirements. A total of 20 people are expected to take part in this research.

facts.sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio
